name: CRA Annex VII draft structure (informational)
description: Structural file/header gates for CRA Annex VII drafts and dependency hygiene — not essential-requirements conformity. Informational — not a conformity assessment.

rules.description: CRA Annex VII risk assessment draft missing, too short, or lacking required section headers.
rules.remediation: Populate docs/annex-vii/risk_assessment.md with product-specific risk models (no placeholders).
rules.expected: Risk assessment exceeds structural thresholds and contains required headers.

rules.description: Support period rationale missing or incomplete.
rules.remediation: Declare a concrete product support period and rationale in docs/annex-vii/support_period.md.
rules.expected: Support period document present with End of Support section.

rules.remediation: Add Secure Configuration and Product Disposal guidance.

rules.description: Annex VII drafts contain placeholder / boilerplate text.
rules.remediation: Replace TODO / lorem ipsum / [insert ...] placeholders with real product content.
rules.expected: No placeholder patterns in Annex VII drafts.

rules.description: Vulnerable axios@1.6.0 pin detected in package.json.
rules.remediation: Upgrade axios to a patched release (>=1.8.4 recommended) and refresh the lockfile.
rules.expected: Dependency tree free of listed unmitigated axios pins.
